General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
The Locating Lever Bolt goes inside the upper transmission housing and guides the shifter’s movement through gear changes
The Sheet Shifter goes inside the Transmission shifter housing and sits under the shifter
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Lever Locating Bolt (Small 10mm)
Qty 1 – Sheet Shift (Transmission)
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1989 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1989 All Models
